description: Test suite for the utility functions and behaviors related to managing members, budgets, and object permissions within the litellm proxy module. It uses pytest and mocking to verify correct behavior of functions like add_new_member and attach_object_permission_to_dict.

methods.name: test_add_new_member_uses_default_team_budget_id()
methods.description: Verifies that add_new_member uses default_team_budget_id when max_budget_in_team is None.

methods.name: test_add_new_member_creates_new_budget_when_max_budget_provided()
methods.description: Checks that a new budget is created and used when max_budget_in_team is specified.

methods.name: test_add_new_member_with_user_email()
methods.description: Tests behavior when the member is specified by email rather than user_id, ensuring proper user creation and budget assignment.

methods.name: test_attach_object_permission_to_dict_with_object_permission_id()
methods.description: Ensures that attach_object_permission_to_dict correctly attaches object_permission data when object_permission_id exists and is found.

methods.name: test_attach_object_permission_to_dict_without_object_permission_id()
methods.description: Verifies that the function returns the original dict unchanged if object_permission_id is not present.

methods.name: test_attach_object_permission_to_dict_object_permission_not_found()
methods.description: Checks that the function handles a missing object permission gracefully.

methods.name: test_attach_object_permission_to_dict_with_dict_method()
methods.description: Ensures compatibility with object permission objects that use .dict() method instead of .model_dump().

methods.name: test_attach_object_permission_to_dict_with_none_prisma_client()
methods.description: Verifies that the function raises an error if the prisma client is None.

methods.name: test_attach_object_permission_to_dict_with_empty_dict()
methods.description: Checks behavior with an empty dictionary, ensuring no database calls are made.

methods.name: test_attach_object_permission_to_dict_with_none_object_permission_id()
methods.description: Ensures no database call occurs when object_permission_id is None.
